arxiv-2109-06394.title: Dynamical Systems of Correspondences on the Projective Line I: Moduli Spaces and Multiplier Maps
arxiv-2109-06394.creator: Rin Gotou
arxiv-2109-06394.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rin Gotou. We consider moduli spaces of dynamical systems of correspondences over the projective line as a generalization of moduli spaces of dynamical systems of endomorphisms on the projective line. We obtain the rationality of the moduli spaces. The rationality of the moduli space of degree ( d , e ) (d,e) correspondences is obtained by constructing a projection to the one for the usual dynamical systems of degree d + e − 1 d+e-1 representation-theoretically.

arxiv-2201-02601.title: Apples and Cars: a Comparison of Security
arxiv-2201-02601.creator: Zhendong Ma
arxiv-2201-02601.description: Abstract . Cybersecurity has gained importance for cars that increasingly rely on software and networks. “Smartphone on wheels” is often used as an analogy to highlight the need for security. As a high-value target of cyberattacks, modern smartphones implement layers of protection. Automotive embedded systems share many similarities with smartphones.

arxiv-2301-10500.title: Banker Online Mirror Descent: A Universal Approach for Delayed Online Bandit Learning
arxiv-2301-10500.creator: Jiatai Huang, Yan Dai, Longbo Huang
arxiv-2301-10500.description: Abstract We propose Banker Online Mirror Descent ( Banker-OMD ), a novel framework generalizing the classical Online Mirror Descent (OMD) technique in the online learning literature. The Banker-OMD framework almost completely decouples feedback delay handling and the task-specific OMD algorithm design, thus facilitating the design of new algorithms capable of efficiently and robustly handling feedback delays.

arxiv-2312-04646.title: Constraints on the trilinear and quartic Higgs couplings from triple Higgs production at the LHC and beyond
arxiv-2312-04646.creator: Panagiotis Stylianou, Georg Weiglein
arxiv-2312-04646.description: Abstract Experimental information on the trilinear Higgs boson self-coupling κ 3 \kappa_{3} and the quartic self-coupling κ 4 \kappa_{4} will be crucial for gaining insight into the shape of the Higgs potential and the nature of the electroweak phase transition.

arxiv-2401-05286.title: A class of locally recoverable codes over finite chain rings
arxiv-2401-05286.creator: Giulia Cavicchioni, Alessio Meneghetti, Eleonora Guerrini
arxiv-2401-05286.description: Abstract . Locally recoverable codes deal with the task of reconstructing a lost symbol by relying on a portion of the remaining coordinates smaller than an information set. We consider the case of codes over finite chain rings, generalizing known results and bounds for codes over fields.

arxiv-2402-02257.title: Cooling and heating regions of Joule-Thomson expansion for AdS black holes: Einstein-Maxwell-Power-Yang-Mills and Kerr Sen black holes
arxiv-2402-02257.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the Joule-Thomson Expansion (JTE) process for two types of black holes: AdS-Einstein–Maxwell-Power-Yang–Mills (AEMPYM) and AdS-Kerr-Sen (AKS). Our study focuses on understanding how various parameters influence the Joule-Thomson Coefficient (JTC), the inversion curve, and the ratio of minimum inversion temperature to critical temperature.

arxiv-2404-18234.title: Bayesian optimization for state engineering of quantum gases
arxiv-2404-18234.creator: Gabriel Müller 1, V. J. Martínez-Lahuerta 1, Ivan Sekulic 2,3, Sven Burger 2,3, Philipp-Immanuel Schneider 2,3, Naceur Gaaloul 1
arxiv-2404-18234.description: Abstract State engineering of quantum objects is a central requirement in most implementations. In the cases where the quantum dynamics can be described by analytical solutions or simple approximation models, optimal state preparation protocols have been theoretically proposed and experimentally realized.

arxiv-2407-09745.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuehua Su, Desheng Wang, Chao Zhang. arxiv-2503-10247.title: Interpretable Image Classification via Non-parametric Part Prototype Learning
arxiv-2503-10247.creator: Zhijie Zhu 1, Lei Fan 1, Maurice Pagnucco 1, Yang Song 1
arxiv-2503-10247.description: Abstract Classifying images with an interpretable decision-making process is a long-standing problem in computer vision. In recent years, Prototypical Part Networks has gained traction as an approach for self-explainable neural networks, due to their ability to mimic human visual reasoning by providing explanations based on prototypical object parts.

arxiv-2504-12219.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction and Dipole-Exchange Curvature Effects on the Spin-Wave Spectra of Magnetic Nanotubes
arxiv-2504-12219.creator: B. Mimica-Figari, P. Landeros, R. A. Gallardo
arxiv-2504-12219.description: Abstract This work explores spin-wave dynamics in magnetic nanotubes, focusing on the influence of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and curvature. The study uses analytical methods to examine how these factors influence the emergence of nonreciprocity and azimuthal standing waves in nanotubes with longitudinal magnetization along the axis or with a vortex-like magnetization.

pmc-12656041.title: Enhancing Intersection Efficiency: A Comparative Analysis of Converting Single-Lane Roundabout to Turbo Roundabout
pmc-12656041.creator: Kristián Čulík, Alica Kalašová, Peter Fabian, Ján Ondruš
pmc-12656041.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This paper evaluates the operational and safety performance of a conventional single-lane roundabout (SLR) and a turbo roundabout (TR) using a mixed-methods approach. Field traffic counts and turning-movement matrices were collected at the studied intersection in Pezinok (Slovakia). The article describes capacity calculations according to national guidelines (TP 100 and TP 102) and the development of a calibrated and validated microsimulation model. Alternative designs—the existing SLR and a proposed TR conversion—were compared under observed morning and afternoon peak-hour conditions.

pmc-13219434.title: Radiation dose has no significant impact on CT-based bone mineral density measurements in a large-animal model

pmc-13219434.description: Bone mineral density (BMD) is a biomarker for frailty, and CT-derived radiodensity can be extracted fully automatically as a surrogate.
